sentences.en: I think I'm starting to get the hang of it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己开始上手了。

sentences.en: "Have you finished it?" "On the contrary, I'm just starting."
sentences.zh: "你完成了吗？" "恰恰相反，我刚刚开始。"

sentences.en: The weather is supposed to go downhill starting this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 据预报，今天下午天气就开始变差了。

senses.zh: 出发，开始v.出发，启程( start的现在分词 ),起动,提出（问题）,开办
